title: Phase Diagram and Finite Temperature Properties of Negative Coupling Scalar Field Theory
summary: In this work, I consider scalar field theory with negative quartic self-interaction, corresponding to an upside-down classical potential. Despite not possessing a classically stable ground state, such potentials are known to behave properly when treated quantum mechanically, leading to stable and unitary time evolution. Using two different saddle-point expansions for the same theory, I discuss the phase diagram in terms of bare parameters in Euclidean dimensions one to four, as well as the generalization to finite temperature.
